messages:
lina: quick sync on post-launch followups from today's rollout. want to align on what goes into our fast-follow vs next sprint backlog.

sara: summary of signals so far: 4 customer reports (2 reproducible), 1 telemetry spike in tail latency for embeddings, and a pilot ask that would likely increase trial conversion.

lina: propose a simple triage rubric so we don't debate each item:
- Hotfix (<=48h): P0 regressive or SLA-impacting for paying customers (customer-impact score >=8).
- Fast-follow (3-7 days): revenue-linked UX or small-engineering (<3 dev-days) items flagged by pilots.
- Backlog: everything else, groom into next sprint based on priority.

tom: +1 on the rubric. can we add a stability flag for telemetry-only items? i.e., items that don't have customer-visible errors but degrade 99th pct should be fast-follow if they affect >=5% of requests.

kevin: ops note 1: for embedding tail latency, we saw KV cache churn on long sequences after the new attention heuristic. mitigation options: a soft throttle on input length, or a targeted revert of that heuristic in canary. revert would be ~4 dev-hours and low risk. throttle is config-only.

ops-bot: alert: embeddings-tail-latency spike at 2026-03-20T21:05Z, affected region: us-west-2, 99p increased from 220ms -> 1200ms for 0.7% of requests.

sara: customer tickets: #5412 (search ranking regressions, reproducible), #5415 (embed timeout, intermittent), #5420 (pilot UX: CTA wording + modal flow). #5412 is the highest immediate customer pain.

lina: decision suggestions:
- #5412 (search ranking) => Hotfix. assign sara to own the fix + QA.
- embedding tail latency => Ops mitigation now (throttle) + engineering revert in canary (kevin to lead).
- pilot UX (#5420) => Fast-follow if engineering can do it in 3 dev-days; otherwise schedule for next sprint and provide interim workaround copy change.

tom: estimate for #5412 is ~8-12 hours (data normalization bug). can do a quick PR today and ship patch.

kevin: will prepare a canary revert branch and a config throttle. recommend canary in us-west-2 then eu-west-1. will monitor GPU mem and 95/99p latencies.

ops-bot: Canary job started: branch=stability/revert-attn-heuristic, target=canary-us-west-2, initiated_by=kevin.

release-bot: New candidate: rc-2026.03.21-fastfollow-1 built. CI: 705; scheduled canary deploy.

sara: onboarding note for customer comms: we'll mark #5412 as "Pushed Fix (rolling)" and provide ETA 24h for full rollout. if patch completes earlier we'll update.

lina: ok final call: everyone align?

kevin: +1, will post canary metrics and flag rollback criteria.

tom: +1, picking up #5412 PR work tonight.

sara: +1, i'll handle customer comms and QA signoff.

lina: I'll draft a brief external status update if we hit RC+canary good. Also adding these items to the grooming board with labels: hotfix/fastfollow/backlog and a customer-impact-score field.

lina: post-thread checklist for handoff:
- Owner: #5412 -> tom (PR, QA), target RC within 12h.
- Owner: embeddings tail -> kevin (throttle config + canary revert).
- Owner: pilot UX -> sara + design; aim for dev slot in fast-follow window, else schedule next sprint.
- Communications: sara to update customers, lina to prepare public status if rollout changes.

lina: thanks all. I'll run a 9:00 sync if canary metrics look good.
